title: flywheel: orch_rescue input
description: [DEPRECATED — use flywheel_rescue instead; removed in v4.0] Build a Codex rescue packet for a stalled plan, implementation, or review phase; materialize the phase artifact when needed; render a dispatch-ready Codex prompt; and store the canonical rescue event in CASS. Returns { packet, codexPrompt, memoryLine }.

phase.description: The stalled flywheel phase to rescue

beadId.description: Optional bead id for implementation or review rescue; falls back to state.currentBeadId

errorEnvelope.description: Optional FlywheelToolError-shaped object. code and hint are copied into the rescue packet.

message.description: Error message from the stalled operation

hint.description: Actionable hint copied verbatim into the packet

notes.description: Optional proposed next step or phase-specific context for the rescue agent
